title: Two drops into one technician at once show a board-busy alert
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. A second user with Work Orders view and create and edit (e.g. "Sam Second", Admin role) in a second browser, both screens side by side.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create two Approved work orders led by Esther Howard for the case customer (e.g. "S1-701", "S1-702").
custom_steps:
1. In both browsers open Work Orders, click the All tab, pick Board View and search for the case customer.
  2. In browser 1 start dragging "S1-701" over Ralph Edwards' column; in browser 2 start dragging "S1-702" over Ralph Edwards' column.
  3. Count 3-2-1 and release both at the same moment (keep shifts if asked).
  4. Read any alert in either browser and where each card ends up.
  5. Repeat steps 2 to 4 up to five times, then reload both browsers.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the second drop cannot be saved in time, that browser shows an alert reading exactly: The board is busy with another move. Please try again. and its card goes back to where it was.
  • Two people dropping at exactly the same moment cannot be guaranteed by hand. If every drop saved, write 'busy alert not reproduced by hand' in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see: no card may be lost or shown twice, and after the reload each card is in exactly one column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N12, read 8 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward 6 Oct 2026. Jira SV-10985 (a held column lock makes drops fail as 'busy'). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N12: “When two people drop into the same technician at the same moment and the second cannot be saved in time, the alert reads “The board is busy with another move. Please try again.” and the card goes back to where it was.”
